ITEM 1 | Two elongated dark reddish-brown cylindrical pieces, glossy with slight sheen, firm, smooth surface with some darker browned/charred spots, roughly 12-13 cm long and about 2 cm wide, lying diagonally across the upper-left of the plate, one partly overlapping the other | 90
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow scrambled mass with soft, moist, fluffy curds and some flowing edges, interspersed with small orange-red diced pieces and bits of paler yellow, covering roughly 35% of the plate on the lower-right side, about 2-3 cm tall in a mound | 110
